text:
Aisha: Heads up 11 Our calibration packet export contains raw manager comments. Legal asked to redact PII and candidate names before sharing with cross-functional reviewers. Can we run a quick redaction pass?
PeopleOpsBot: Calibration export v3 available at /private/exports/calibration_v3.csv (automated run).
Tom: Good catch. Do we have an automated redaction script or is this manual?
Aisha: We have a simple redaction script but it misses nicknames and occasional internal IDs. Plan: run script -> spot-check 20 random rows -> follow-up manual edits where needed. Need volunteers.
Carla: I can spot-check after lunch. How many rows are in the export?
Aisha: ~420 employees in this cycle, export is ~420 rows. We're only sending anonymized packets to product and sales reviewers (about ~35 people), so we must be careful.
Evan: I can run the script now and output columns we should drop. Which fields are definitely sensitive?
Aisha: Candidate/peer names, manager private notes, any calendar links, file attachments references, and internal ticket IDs. Keep ratings, examples, and public-facing context.
Tom: Suggest adding a new column "source_note_removed" that flags rows where redaction changed the text so reviewers can ask for context during calibration rather than guessing.
Carla: Agree. Also recommend a short blurb at top of packet: "This packet has been redacted for privacy. For clarification during calibration contact People Ops."
PeopleOpsBot: Redaction script run complete. 17 rows flagged for manual review (nicknames/internal IDs). Output saved as calibration_v3_redacted.csv.
Aisha: Thanks bot. @Carla can you review the 17 flagged rows and mark any that still contain PII with the tag "PII_REVIEW" in the comment column? We'll not release packet until cleared.
Carla: Will do. ETA 90m.
Evan: While Carla reviews, I'll prepare the blurb and the instructions for reviewers about what to expect in anonymized packets. Draft blurb: "Packet redacted to remove names and private manager notes. If you need context, please submit a calibration query to people-ops with the packet row ID. Do not attempt to identify employees." Thoughts?
Tom: Add note about how to surface concerns: "If you suspect redaction removed critical context, tag the row and People Ops will facilitate a private clarification with the manager."
Aisha: Perfect. Also add a reminder about not sharing packet outside calibration cohort.
Carla: Done review. I marked 17 rows: 5 needed additional redaction for internal ticket IDs; 3 had nicknames that were ambiguous. I replaced nicknames with generic roles (e.g., "peer"). Marked those rows as "PII_REVIEW" where I couldn't confidently remove identity.
PeopleOpsBot: PeopleOps reminder: calibration packets will be published to reviewers at 10:00 UTC tomorrow unless a PII_REVIEW is unresolved.
Evan: How many unresolved?
Aisha: 3 unresolved (Carla flagged). We have two options: delay publication 24h to resolve or ship without those 3 rows (and follow up separately). Which do you prefer?
Tom: If we ship without 3 rows, we risk incomplete dataset for calibration. I vote for 24h delay.
Carla: I can reach out to the three managers now and get sanitized replacements within 6 hours. If they respond quickly, we can keep the original timeline.
Evan: OK let's delay 12h instead of 24h to minimize impact. Publish at 22:00 UTC if cleared, otherwise push 24h. I'll update the PeopleOpsBot schedule.
PeopleOpsBot: Publication rescheduled to 22:00 UTC pending PII_REVIEW clearance.
Aisha: Thanks team. After publication I'll follow up with a short note to calibration leads with the blurb + an ask to keep questions in-thread rather than forwarding.
Tom: One procedural note: let's add a pre-export redaction checklist to the playbook so this doesn't become ad hoc next quarter.
Aisha: Agreed. I'll draft checklist and share in #docs/playbooks.
Carla: Done reaching out to managers. Two already replied with sanitized comments; one manager asked for an example of acceptable redaction (I sent templates).
Aisha: Great. Once the last one replies, update the PII_REVIEW flag to "cleared". Thanks all.
Evan: I'll also add a small field in the export: "redaction_version" pointing to the script hash so we can audit later.
PeopleOpsBot: Publication triggered at 22:00 UTC (or earlier if cleared).
Aisha: Closing for now. If anything changes ping me directly.
